brief:
Heavy rain in central Gaza caused a sand embankment to collapse onto tents housing displaced families, killing three children and one woman, Mondoweiss reported. The deaths occurred as winter weather intensifies across the territory.

Displacement camps throughout Gaza face mounting dangers from seasonal storms, flooding, and landslides. Tens of thousands of Palestinians live in tents and informal shelters lacking adequate protection from severe weather.
dek: Three children and one woman were killed in central Gaza after heavy rain caused a sand embankment to collapse onto displaced families' tents.
title: Rain collapse kills four in Gaza displacement camp
